text:
natalie: Heads up
ruby SDK gem native extension is failing on our CI runners for windows/arm64. failing job: https://ci.redwood/sdk-ruby/1122
ben: Error log?
natalie: excerpt: 
```
ERROR: Failed to build gem native extension.
current directory: /workspace/redwood-ext/ext/redwood_ffi
mkmf.rb cannot find header files for ruby at /opt/hostedtoolcache/Ruby/3.2.2/include/ruby-3.2.0
```
raj: hmm we've seen this flaky when the runner image changed and the devkit for arm64 was missing. Are we pinning the msys2 toolchain in the gemspec CI job?
natalie: CI job uses the shared runner image `redwood/ci-ruby:latest` which recently bumped to ruby 3.2.3 and the msys2 packages weren't installed for arm64 variant.
ben: Quick fix: vendor a precompiled gem for windows/arm64 in the matrix so CI doesn't try to compile. Longer term we should add a job step to install msys2 runtime only when platform =~ /mingw|mswin/.
maya: Would adding the prebuilt wheel/gem artifact to our internal registry be acceptable? we already do that for the embedders lib.
raj: yes, publishing a platform gem (gem push with --platform x64-mingw32 or ruby platform for arm64) would work. But we need to ensure the ext is built reproducibly and signed.
natalie: For the immediate PR I pushed: "fix(ci): skip native build on windows/arm64 by installing prebuilt artifact" https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-ruby/pull/478 
ben: thx. small nit on the PR: prefer to use `RUBY_PLATFORM` checks in the job script instead of OS name so matrix behaves consistently. also add a comment referencing the runner image change.
maya: also add a smoke test that requires the gem to be the platform-specific package when running on windows runner so we detect regressions early.
raj: can we also add a short blurb to the CONTRIBUTING.md about building native ext locally (msys2 install lines) so community contributors aren't blocked?
natalie: added a commit with msys2 install snippet and a link to GitHub Actions svc cache for the devkit.
ci-bot: CI queued for PR 478: https://ci.redwood/sdk-ruby/478 :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ci-bot: CI passed for PR 478: https://ci.redwood/sdk-ruby/478 :white_check_mark:
ben: LGTM after CI. I'll merge and then follow up with a backport to the 1.x branch since a customer reported the same on self-hosted runners.
maya: great. Also worth surfacing in the release notes: "Fix: CI & Windows/arm64 native gem handling to avoid build failures"
natalie: will add the release note line. thanks all. :thumbsup:
